The vibration 
sensor
39V 1,2,3. Dwg no. 158A7476 P008, Mfg: VITEC, USA,

The first draft initiated by eng. Taher 
Abdel Galel, tested by eng. Tarek El Sayed Abdel Razeq at 02 June

accepted by general director eng. Yousry Abd El-Maksuod, and approved by eng. 
Mostafa Allam head sector of Talkha PS
Check the cable of the sensor for tightness

Check the output impedance IMP (Z) value
 < 500 ohms at temp (0 F to 400 F)
Check the output voltage 200 mV at 1" / sec
Repeat the steps from 1 to 4 for 39V2, 39V3
